핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

국내외 금리 환경을 둘러싼 불확실성이 고조되는 가운데, 한국은행 유상대 부총재가 5월 금융통화위원회에서 금리 인상 시그널이 나올 수 있다고 언급해 통화정책 방향에 시장의 이목이 집중되고 있다. 해외에서도 월가 전문가들이 연준 의장 교체 가능성을 두고 채권 시장이 두 가지 위험에 직면했다고 경고하고 있으며, 엘 에리언은 전쟁 리스크로 인해 미국 경제 예외주의가 더욱 흔들릴 수 있다고 진단해 글로벌 금융시장의 변동성이 한층 높아진 상황이다. 이러한 긴축 우려가 확산되는 속에서 국내 부동산 시장에도 변화의 조짐이 감지되는데, 양도세 중과 시행을 일주일 앞두고 급매물이 이미 소화된 것으로 전해져 세제 변화를 앞두고 단기 거래는 사실상 마무리 국면에 접어들었다. 전반적으로 오늘의 경제 흐름은 **금리 인상 압력, 정책 불확실성, 부동산 세제 변화**가 맞물리며 투자자들의 셈법이 한층 복잡해지는 하루였다고 볼 수 있다.

key_headlines.title: Korean Growth Outlook Revised Upward; Rate Hike Signals Emerge
key_headlines.summary: Major global investment banks have raised Korea's growth and inflation forecasts, with the Bank of Korea officially mentioning the possibility of rate hikes after seven consecutive holds. Market expectations point to a potential July rate increase followed by additional hikes, reaching 3% by year-end.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Reaches All-Time High; Semiconductor Momentum Drives Markets
key_headlines.summary: The Korean stock market hit record highs with KOSPI surpassing 6,700, driven by strong semiconductor earnings and foreign investor inflows. KOSDAQ also rose over 2% amid positive market sentiment.

key_headlines.title: Housing Transfer Tax Surcharge Implementation One Week Away; Rapid Sales Spike
key_headlines.summary: With the implementation of heightened transfer tax surcharges just one week away, property owners have rushed to complete sales. Real estate experts and agents remain divided on house price outlook for 2026, with experts predicting rises while brokers forecast declines.

key_headlines.title: Trump Ridicules Fed Chair Powell; Pressure Mounts for Rate Cuts
key_headlines.summary: President Trump posted mocking images of Fed Chair Powell in a trash bin, pressuring the Federal Reserve to lower rates amid concerns about elevated interest rates. This comes as the Fed maintained rates unchanged at its latest meeting.

key_headlines.title: AI Data Center Construction Delays Threaten US Infrastructure; 40% of Projects at Risk
key_headlines.summary: Rising costs of essential components like optical fiber and multilayer ceramic capacitors threaten approximately 40% of planned US AI data centers with construction delays. Infrastructure cost inflation raises concerns about AI service subscription increases being passed to consumers.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's economy shows strong momentum with first-quarter real GDP growth of 1.7%, the highest in six years, driven primarily by semiconductor boom and related investments. However, the economy displays mixed signals with semiconductor strength contrasting sharply against weakness in other sectors. Global investment banks have raised Korea's 2026 growth and inflation forecasts, while the Bank of Korea has signaled potential rate hikes, marking a potential shift from the previous easing cycle. The housing market faces uncertainty ahead of impending transfer tax surcharge implementation.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea has formally acknowledged the possibility of rate hikes as early as May's monetary policy committee meeting, signaling a shift toward tightening after seven consecutive holds. Major investment banks have unanimously raised their growth rate forecasts for Korea, citing strong semiconductor-led exports and capital investment. Inflation pressures from international oil prices and domestic demand continue to build, with central bank officials publicly discussing the need to consider rate increases. Market consensus projects the first rate hike in July, followed by another increase to bring rates to approximately 3% by year-end.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI reached an all-time high, surpassing 6,700 points, with foreign investors and institutions driving the rally through significant net purchases. KOSDAQ also advanced over 2% in tandem with the broader market momentum. US Treasury yields have risen sharply, with 30-year yields breaking above 5% amid geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and concerns about American fiscal sustainability. Global equity funds recorded six consecutive weeks of inflows, while bond funds also attracted sustained investor interest across government and high-yield categories.
sections.Industry & Technology: Samsung Electronics made a surprise personnel shift, replacing its TV division head with Lee Won-jin to drive innovation in the display sector, signaling management's focus on semiconductor-level breakthroughs. Samsung Display and LG Display jointly showcased next-generation K-display technologies, including EL-QD and third-generation tandem OLED, which offer improved power efficiency and longer lifespan. Korea Hydro and Nuclear Power is implementing safety measures and flexible operation systems for nuclear power plants to accommodate renewable energy integration. The semiconductor industry remains the primary growth engine, though supply chain vulnerabilities exist regarding critical materials.
sections.Real Estate: Real estate experts and brokers hold sharply divergent views on 2026 housing prices, with professionals expecting 56% to predict appreciation while brokers at 54% forecast declines, a significant reversal from January's consensus for price increases. Monthly rent has surged with over 70% of apartments in the Seoul metropolitan area now offered as monthly leases rather than traditional deposits, placing greater burden on tenants due to accelerating전세 phobia. Transfer tax surcharge implementation one week away has triggered rapid property sales as owners rush to complete transactions before the tax increase takes effect. Polarization between Seoul's Gangnam area and other regions continues, with Gangnam facing price adjustments while non-Seoul areas show weak supply.
sections.International Economy: President Trump continues to pressure Federal Reserve Chair Powell on monetary policy, publicly mocking him and demanding rate cuts despite the Fed maintaining unchanged rates. Global tensions escalated with renewed Middle East security concerns affecting oil prices and bond markets, pushing US Treasury yields higher. El-Erian warned that global conflicts increasingly challenge American exceptionalism and economic stability. Wall Street analysts caution that Fed leadership transitions create dual risks for bond market stability, particularly given elevated geopolitical uncertainty.
sections.AI & Economy: Approximately 40% of planned US AI data centers face construction delays due to soaring component costs including optical fiber and multilayer ceramic capacitors, mirroring the memory semiconductor super-cycle. AI infrastructure cost inflation threatens to ripple through the entire industry, with potential for AI service subscription increases being passed to consumers. Data center site acquisition and construction demand are reshaping commercial real estate markets, while energy and infrastructure assets gain new investment relevance. Companies like Lumida and Studio Metakey are collaborating on generative AI-based content development, combining AI animation with physical kinetic media for next-generation entertainment experiences.
sections.Others: Korea's trade association participated in major US investment conferences, raising concerns about tariffs and trade barriers affecting Korean companies amid ongoing US trade policy uncertainty.
